title: Sightseeing
summary: Spend a day in Petra with a guide: talk about famous places with comparatives and superlatives, ask polite questions, and tell the story of the visit in the past.
intro: Early on Sunday morning Daniel, Layla and Yusuf walk into Petra with a guide called Khalid. Today brings the whole week together: polite questions like هَلْ مِنَ الْمُمْكِن أَنْ نَرْكَبَهُ؟ (could we ride it?), comparatives like أَكْبَرُ مِنَ الصُّوَر (bigger than in the photos), superlatives like أَشْهَرُ مَكَان فِي الْبَتْرَاء (the most famous place in Petra) and مِنْ أَجْمَلِ الْقِصَص (one of the most beautiful stories), and hollow verbs like نَزُورُ (we visit).
objectives: Use eight sightseeing words: tourist, guide, entrance, rock, tomb, camel, ruins and to carve
Describe famous places with comparatives and superlatives
Ask a guide politely for help and information
Understand a short past-tense story about a visit

realLife.title: A morning in the Rose City
realLife.story: At seven in the morning the Siq, the narrow gorge into Petra, is cool and almost empty. Khalid, a guide from Wadi Musa, knows every rock and every story. Daniel takes a hundred photos, Layla wants to ride a camel, and Yusuf, who has seen the Treasury nine times before, is just as happy as his friends.

sentences.en: The Treasury is the most famous place in Petra.
sentences.literal: the Treasury (is the) most famous place in Petra

sentences.en: The Monastery is farther away than the Treasury.
sentences.literal: the Monastery (is) farther than the Treasury

sentences.en: The Nabataeans carved the city into the rock.
sentences.literal: carved the Nabataeans the city in the rock

mistakes.why: When the verb comes before its subject, it stays singular, even before a plural: naḥata l-anbāṭ.

sentences.en: Take a photo of me in front of the Treasury, please. (to a woman)
sentences.literal: photograph me in front of the Treasury, from your kindness

mistakes.why: 'Me' after a verb is the ending -nī: ṣawwirīnī.

sentences.ar: الْبَتْرَاء مِنْ أَجْمَلِ الْأَمَاكِن فِي الْعَالَم.
sentences.en: Petra is one of the most beautiful places in the world.
sentences.literal: Petra (is) of the most beautiful (of) the places in the world
the tourists they visit Petra every day

dialogue.title: A day in Petra
dialogue.culture: Petra was the capital of the Nabataeans, Arab traders who grew rich from the caravans that carried incense and spices. Its most famous building, الْخَزْنَة (the Treasury), is carved straight out of the pink rock. In 2007 Petra was chosen as one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. Inside the site you can ride a camel, a horse or a donkey, but every guide gives the same advice: bring water and good shoes.

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر، وَأَهْلًا بِكُمْ فِي الْبَتْرَاء! أَنَا خَالِد، دَلِيلُكُمُ الْيَوْمَ. هٰذَا هُوَ الْمَدْخَل، وَمِنْ هُنَا نَمْشِي إِلَى السِّيق.
lines.en: Good morning, and welcome to Petra! I'm Khalid, your guide today. This is the entrance, and from here we walk to the Siq.

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور يَا خَالِد. جِئْنَا مُبَكِّرًا كَمَا قَالَتْ لَنَا مُوَظَّفَةُ الْفُنْدُق، وَالسُّيَّاح قَلِيلُونَ الْآنَ.
lines.en: Good morning, Khalid. We came early, as the hotel receptionist told us, and there aren't many tourists yet.

lines.ar: أَحْسَنْتُمْ، هٰذَا أَفْضَلُ وَقْت لِلزِّيَارَة. السِّيق مَمَرّ ضَيِّق بَيْنَ الصُّخُور، وَطُولُهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ كِيلُومِتْر.
lines.en: Well done, this is the best time for a visit. The Siq is a narrow passage between the rocks, and it's more than a kilometre long.

lines.ar: مَا أَجْمَلَ لَوْنَ الصُّخُور! هِيَ وَرْدِيَّة وَحَمْرَاء. هَلْ لِهٰذَا السَّبَب يُسَمُّونَهَا الْمَدِينَةَ الْوَرْدِيَّة؟
lines.en: What a beautiful colour the rocks are! They're pink and red. Is that why they call it the Rose City?
segs: the pink, the rose (f) ('the Rose City')

lines.ar: بِالضَّبْط! الْأَنْبَاط نَحَتُوا هٰذِهِ الْمَدِينَة فِي الصَّخْر قَبْلَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَلْفَيْ سَنَة، وَكَانَتْ مَدِينَة غَنِيَّة جِدًّا.
lines.en: Exactly! The Nabataeans carved this city into the rock more than two thousand years ago, and it was a very rich city.

lines.ar: اُنْظُرُوا إِلَى الْأَمَام! هٰذِهِ هِيَ الْخَزْنَة، أَشْهَرُ مَكَان فِي الْبَتْرَاء. وَأَنَا أَرَاهَا الْيَوْمَ لِلْمَرَّة الْعَاشِرَة!
lines.en: Look ahead! This is the Treasury, the most famous place in Petra. And today I'm seeing it for the tenth time!

lines.ar: يَا سَلَام! هِيَ أَكْبَرُ وَأَجْمَلُ مِنَ الصُّوَر بِكَثِير. يَا لَيْلَى، صَوِّرِينِي أَمَامَهَا، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ!
lines.en: Wow! It's much bigger and more beautiful than in the photos. Layla, take a photo of me in front of it, please!

lines.ar: طَبْعًا، اِبْتَسِمْ! وَالْآنَ صُورَة مَعَ ذٰلِكَ الْجَمَل. هَلْ مِنَ الْمُمْكِن أَنْ نَرْكَبَهُ يَا خَالِد؟
lines.en: Of course, smile! And now a photo with that camel. Khalid, is it possible for us to ride it?

lines.ar: مُمْكِن، لٰكِنْ بَعْدَ الزِّيَارَة. أَوَّلًا نَزُورُ الْمَسْرَح وَالْقُبُور الْمَلَكِيَّة، ثُمَّ نَصْعَدُ إِلَى الدَّيْر.
lines.en: It's possible, but after the visit. First we'll visit the theatre and the Royal Tombs, then we'll climb up to the Monastery.

lines.ar: الدَّيْر أَبْعَدُ مَكَان، وَفِي الطَّرِيق إِلَيْهِ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ ثَمَانِمِئَةِ دَرَجَة. لٰكِنَّ الْمَنْظَر مِنْ فَوْقُ أَجْمَلُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْء.
lines.en: The Monastery is the farthest place, and on the way up there are more than eight hundred steps. But the view from the top is more beautiful than anything.

lines.ar: كُلُّ هٰذِهِ الدَّرَجَات؟! إِذَنْ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَرْكَبَ حِمَارًا، فَالْحِمَار أَقْوَى مِنِّي وَأَسْرَعُ!
lines.en: All those steps?! Then I want to ride a donkey, because a donkey is stronger and faster than me!

lines.ar: كُلُّ السُّيَّاح يَقُولُونَ ذٰلِكَ! لٰكِنْ صَدِّقْنِي، الْمَشْي أَفْضَلُ، وَالْحِمَار يَتْعَبُ أَيْضًا.
lines.en: All the tourists say that! But believe me, walking is better, and the donkey gets tired too.

lines.ar: طَيِّب، نَمْشِي. وَفِي الطَّرِيق، هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَحْكِيَ لَنَا قِصَّةَ الْأَنْبَاط يَا خَالِد؟
lines.en: OK, we'll walk. And on the way, Khalid, could you tell us the story of the Nabataeans?

lines.ar: بِكُلِّ سُرُور! قِصَّتُهُمْ مِنْ أَجْمَلِ الْقِصَص فِي تَارِيخِ الْعَرَب. هَيَّا، اِتْبَعُونِي، وَلَا تَنْسَوْا أَنْ تَشْرَبُوا الْمَاء!
lines.en: With pleasure! Their story is one of the most beautiful stories in Arab history. Come on, follow me, and don't forget to drink water!
segs: you drink (to several people, after an)

lines.ar: هٰذَا أَجْمَلُ يَوْم فِي رِحْلَتِنَا. شُكْرًا يَا يُوسُف عَلَى هٰذِهِ الرِّحْلَة، أَنْتَ أَفْضَلُ صَدِيق!
lines.en: This is the most beautiful day of our trip. Thank you for this trip, Yusuf; you're the best friend anyone could have!

reading.title: Our day in Petra
reading.ar: صَبَاحَ يَوْمِ الْأَحَد زَارَ دَانْيَال وَلَيْلَى وَيُوسُف الْبَتْرَاء مَعَ دَلِيل اسْمُهُ خَالِد. مَشَوْا فِي السِّيق بَيْنَ الصُّخُور الْوَرْدِيَّة، ثُمَّ شَاهَدُوا الْخَزْنَة، أَشْهَرَ مَكَان فِي الْبَتْرَاء. بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ زَارُوا الْقُبُور وَالْآثَار، وَصَعِدُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَمَانِمِئَةِ دَرَجَة إِلَى الدَّيْر. كَانَ هٰذَا أَجْمَلَ يَوْم فِي رِحْلَتِهِمْ.
reading.en: On Sunday morning Daniel, Layla and Yusuf visited Petra with a guide called Khalid. They walked through the Siq between the pink rocks, then they saw the Treasury, the most famous place in Petra. After that they visited the tombs and the ruins, and climbed more than eight hundred steps to the Monastery. It was the most beautiful day of their trip.

options: a narrow passage between the rocks

quiz.prompt: How many steps are there on the way to the Monastery?
Who carved Petra into the rock?
Choose: 'one of the most beautiful places'
Why does Daniel want to ride a donkey?
